name: smwpatches-separate-mario-and-luigi-game-over-themes
title: Separate Mario and Luigi Game Over themes
description:
Yay! My very first Asar patch!
This patch allows Mario and Luigi to have separate Game Over Themes! This also fixes a bug where Luigi doesn’t have Game Over music!

Bug: [url=https://youtu.be/ht23bzUt8wE]

Note: Go to AMK's asm/SNES/tweaks.asm, go org $00D0DE and comment out (add semicolons ; at the start of each line) for the following lines:
Code
org $00D0DE
	db !GameOver

versions.title: Separate Mario and Luigi Game Over themes
